data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Classification: behavioral (code defect in merge-to-main-pr.sh). Fail-loud safety property of bug 9e04-0eb6 preserved when dispatch is actually needed (threads present + LLM unset). RED→GREEN test added at tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh: test_phase_resolve_threads_settles_clean_when_no_threads_and_llm_unset; existing test_phase_resolve_threads_fails_loud_when_llm_dispatch_unset updated to use threads_one_unresolved stub scenario. 38/38 pass.
